item.description: The 31-year-old TVSN's final show was broadcast earlier this month after its owners failed to secure new investment or a buyer for the network.

item.title: ABC News: Calls for census investigation as country towns claim ABS underestimates them
item.description: Communities in WA's Wheatbelt say failed deliveries of census material mean their local population is being significantly undercounted.

item.title: ABC News: Anthropic's first data centre in Australia given environmental approval
item.description: The National Environmental Protection Agency has determined the $32 billion data centre is unlikely to significantly affect protected animals and plants.

item.title: ABC News: Sydney Swan Papley has driving while suspended charge dismissed
item.description: Tom Papley apologised to his family and the Sydney Swans after having a driving while suspended charge dismissed by a judge.

item.title: ABC News: Geelong teacher's licence suspended amid police investigation
item.description: A Geelong high school teacher's registration has been suspended amid a sexual offences and child abuse police team investigation into allegations relating to a previous role in Bendigo.

item.title: ABC News: Breaking: NT Police investigating emailed terror threat targeting government ministers
item.description: NT Police are investigating an emailed terror threat targeting NT government ministers, bureaucrats and public areas.

item.title: ABC News: Jack Clayton draws on AFL draft experience to chase Test cricket debut
item.description: Jack Clayton, a former member of the Brisbane Lions academy, says missing out on the AFL draft has taught him how to deal with the pressure of chasing a Test debut for Australia after his switch to cricket.

item.title: ABC News: Gordon Ramsay announced as new host of Top Gear to air in 2028
item.description: The celebrity chef will begin filming the new season in 2027 after the show was paused in 2022.

item.title: ABC News: Breaking: QAS Commissioner resigns after ambulance delay deaths
item.description: Craig Emery's five-year contract as commissioner was due to end in February but Health Minister Tim Nicholls announced today Mr Emery had decided to retire from the role.

item.title: ABC News: Taxpayer-funded cleaners not allowed to bend down under aged care rules
item.description: Margaret Harvey is being charged for a cleaner costing $115 per hour who is not allowed to reach up to clean high places or bend down to clean low places.

item.title: ABC News: The reason why North Melbourne dominates the AFLW landscape
item.description: The Kangaroos are eyeing a premiership three-peat in the AFLW, boasting an astonishing 96 per cent win-loss rate across the past three seasons.

item.title: ABC News: Live: Victorian election stoush over dumped Liberal's blue t-shirts back in court
item.description: As the major parties continue their push to election day, Labor are seeking an injunction in the Supreme Court to stop dumped Liberal candidate for Williamstown Paul Lindemann from campaigning in a blue t-shirt. Follow live in our election blog.

item.title: ABC News: Canberra youths to face charges after aggravated robbery
item.description: Four young people have been accused by ACT police of aggravated robbery, after they allegedly held a teenage boy at knifepoint and forced him to transfer money to several bank accounts.
